## Release

If this PR should publish a release, assign exactly one label such as
`release:v0.5.1` before merging. Use `node scripts/release.mjs suggest` to find the
next version. The label selects the future Git tag; do not push that tag yourself.

Opening or updating this PR starts no builds. A tagged PR releases when the
repository owner merges it, or another maintainer merges an approved final
revision into `main`. The author can also use the manual
release flow documented in `docs/RELEASES.md`.
